## Loading the Palmer Penguins Dataset

Finding a relationship between bill length and flipper length

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(count = n())

penguins |>
  drop_na(bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x=bill_length_mm, y=flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + geom_point()
```
